title: refactor(ci): modernize lint/test/release workflows and consolidate caches
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Context: Our repo has accumulated several overlapping CI workflows for linting, testing, and release automation. This causes long queue times on actions runners, duplicated caching logic, and makes it hard to reason about release gating. Motivation: consolidate workflows, standardize cache keys, and modernize matrixes for Node/Go/Python to reduce CI duration and cost while keeping job-level isolation.

What this PR does:
- Unifies lint and test runners into two main workflows: .github/workflows/lint.yml and .github/workflows/test.yml.
- Replaces several repo-specific release workflows with a single, templated .github/workflows/release.yml using the new release-orchestrator composite action.
- Standardizes cache keys across JS/TS SDKs and frontend packages to improve cache hit-rate (node-modules + pnpm-store).
- Introduces job-level parallelism tuning (max-parallel for matrix jobs) and a new default concurrency policy to avoid double runs on rapid pushes.
- Cleans up legacy GitHub Actions that are unused (ci/old-* workflows) and migrates a few integrations to the consolidated flow.

Checklist:
- [x] Consolidate workflows and remove duplicates
- [x] Validate cache key determinism across node toolchains
- [x] Keep per-package lint/test scripts intact (no behavioral changes)
- [x] Add rollout plan & feature flags for release automation
- [x] Confirm CI on main and release branches

Testing performed:
- Ran workflows on temporary branch with the full monorepo matrix (Node 18/20, Python 3.11, Go 1.21) and measured wall time. Median lint time reduced by ~28%, test pipeline median reduced by ~22%.
- Verified release dry-run via release-orchestrator (no publishes) for tags matching release/*
- Manual validation that secret-scoped jobs still restrict access (no change to secret names or scopes)

Rollout plan:
- Merge to main behind standard release freeze window. Monitor CI queue and cache hit metrics in the console for 48h. If regressions seen, revert via revert PR template included here.

Related: Linear ENG-5912 (CI hygiene), ENG-6010 (release automation unification).

release_notes:
- Consolidated lint and test workflows to reduce CI runtime and maintenance overhead.
- Introduced release-orchestrator composite action to standardize release automation across repos.
- Standardized cache keys for pnpm/node to improve cache hit rates.
- Removed legacy/unused workflows.
- No behavioral changes to runtime code; CI-only hygiene and tooling improvements.
notes_for_ops: Monitor CI queue length and cache hit rate in the first 48h after merge (Dashboard: CI -> Cache Efficiency). If average queue time increases by >20% rollback using the provided revert PR template.
security_note: No changes to secret scopes or names. Release jobs still run only on protected branches and use sealed SA tokens managed by ops.
